items.title: 2-year yield rises to highest since January 2025 after hot jobs report boosts expectations that the Fed could raise rates
items.description: Treasury yields rose as the hot jobs report along with sticky inflation may give the Fed more cover to hike interest rates in September.

items.title: Trump tells Fed to slash rates or he'll end trade with countries with U.S. surpluses

items.title: Back-to-school shopping brought to you by AI — how Amazon, Google are positioned to win
items.description: The rise of AI-assisted shopping during this year's back-to-school season may be an early window into evolving consumer buying habits.

items.title: Labor Day marks the start of 'fallcations' as wealthy travelers avoid summer crowds

items.title: Bitcoin heads for third winning week in a row as macro pressures mount
items.description: Bitcoin headed for its third straight winning week, as traders searched for refuge amid volatile moves in equities, currencies and bond markets.

items.title: U.S. payrolls rose 162,000 in August, much more than expected; unemployment rate at 4.1%

items.title: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy as CEO, replacing Shantanu Narayen

items.title: The big business of personal protection: How private security became a $50 billion industry

items.title: Gloria Steinem hosted salons in her living room for decades—how to gather for conversation and connection, says expert

items.title: Volkswagen plans 50,000 job cuts as analysts see ‘halo effect’ for German auto industry

items.title: Lululemon stock plunges 20% on disappointing earnings and outlook
items.description: Lululemon posted another quarter of disappointing results and a sales slowdown as the company struggles to turn its business around.

items.title: THC drinks could soon be harder to find as Congress delays hemp ban again
